text: Steenbarger: no, the camp does not agree. At ratify minervini and livermore want close_above:pivot_high on D and elder-lens wants in_zone:entry; only raschke, seow and wyckoff stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high, so ADVANCE counts seats on a trigger 4 of 7 object to. Even the pivot trigger fails my test: close 121.29 vs ma200 71.38 is 69.9% over, and a close above the swing high 126.4 lands about 77% over, inside the C24 climax zone (R7). Held. Clears on a fresh base back well under 70% over ma200, then a pivot break on day_vol 1.40 or better.
